resources.string: Back opens controls. Home sends Xbox Guide during streaming. Outside streaming, Guide opens Quick Resume.

Replace Back and Home/Guide tap, double and hold actions? Back opens the stream controls or device controls. Home sends a live Xbox Guide press in streams; outside streaming it opens Quick Resume or the radial menu on hold. Your calibrated keys, M1/M2 and other settings stay unchanged. The accessibility service may be needed for physical system keys.
